title: TaCZ - First-person Model compatibility
description: A mod that fixes the duplicate arms when holding a TaCZ gun while the First-person Model mod is active.
body:
A mod that fixes the duplicate arms when holding a TaCZ gun while the First-person Model mod is active.


TaCZ: [https://modrinth.com/mod/tacz-1.21.1](https://modrinth.com/mod/tacz-1.21.1)

First-person Model: [https://modrinth.com/mod/first-person-model](https://modrinth.com/mod/first-person-model)

 


Compatible with Essential Mod: [https://modrinth.com/mod/essential](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential)
